Gaozu also remembered how in former days he had given up his horse and guided and protected him, and bestowed gold and silk very generously before and after, but did not raise his noble rank; Qiong too was depressed.

units.zh: 久之，領橫州刺史。
units.en: After some time he received titular command of Hengzhou.
units.literal: After a long time he held titular command of Hengzhou.

units.zh: 五年，出典申州，微有政聲。
units.en: In the fifth year he governed Shenzhou and gained a modest reputation for good administration.
units.literal: In the fifth year he went out to govern Shenzhou and gained a slight reputation for good administration.

units.zh: 少帝嗣位，入為殿前散員都指揮使，遙領雷州，俄遷棣州刺史。
units.en: When the Young Emperor succeeded he became overall commander of the palace attendants-at-large, held titular command of Lei, and soon became prefect of Di.
units.literal: When the Young Emperor succeeded he entered court as overall commander of the palace attendants-at-large, held titular command of Leizhou, and soon was moved to prefect of Dizhou.

units.zh: 遇楊光遠以青州叛，自統本部兵攻其城，且以書誘瓊，瓊因拒之，以書上進，朝廷嘉之。
units.en: When Yang Guangyuan rebelled from Qingzhou, Qiong led his troops against the city. Guangyuan tried to win him over by letter, but Qiong refused and sent the letter to court, winning praise.
units.literal: When Yang Guangyuan rebelled with Qingzhou, he himself led his unit's troops to attack the city and also tried to entice Qiong by letter; Qiong therefore refused him, forwarded the letter to court, and the court praised him.

units.zh: 開運二年，改洺州團練使，累官至加檢校司空。
units.en: In the second year of Kaiyun he became military training commissioner of Ming and eventually rose to Acting Minister of Works.
units.literal: In the second year of Kaiyun he was made military training commissioner of Mingzhou and rose through offices to Acting Minister of Works.

units.zh: 三年，授護聖右廂都指揮使，領岳州團練使。
units.en: In the third year he was made overall commander of the right wing of the Guarding Sagely Corps and military training commissioner of Yue.
units.literal: In the third year he was appointed overall commander of the right wing of the Guarding Sagely Corps with titular command as military training commissioner of Yuezhou.

units.zh: 時洺州吏民列狀保留，朝廷不允。
units.en: The officials and people of Ming submitted a petition to keep him, but the court refused.
units.literal: At that time the officials and people of Mingzhou submitted a collective petition to retain him; the court did not approve.

units.zh: 及杜重威降敵，改授瓊威州刺史。
units.en: When Du Chongwei surrendered to the enemy, Qiong was reassigned prefect of Wei.
units.literal: When Du Chongwei surrendered to the enemy, Qiong was reassigned as prefect of Weizhou.

units.zh: 行及鄭州，遇群盜攻郡，與方太禦賊，中流矢而卒，年六十五。
units.en: On the road at Zhengzhou he met bandits attacking the city. He and Fang Tai fought them off, but Qiong was killed by an arrow, aged sixty-five.
units.literal: While traveling and reaching Zhengzhou he met bandits attacking the commandery; together with Fang Tai he resisted the bandits, was struck by a flying arrow, and died, aged sixty-five.

units.zh: 高漢筠，字時英，齊州歷山人也。
units.en: Gao Hanyun, courtesy name Shiying, was from Lishan in Qizhou.
units.literal: Gao Hanyun, courtesy name Shiying, was a native of Lishan in Qizhou.

units.zh: 曾祖詣，嘗為是邑令，故家焉。
units.en: His great-grandfather Yi had once been magistrate of that district, and the family settled there.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Yi had once been magistrate of that district, and so the family settled there.

units.zh: 漢筠少好書傳，嘗詣長白山講肄，會唐末齊、魯交兵，梁氏方霸，乃擲筆謁焉，尋納於軍門。
units.en: As a youth Hanyun loved the classics and studied on Mount Changbai. When late Tang saw Qi and Lu at war and Liang was rising, he cast aside his brush, sought service, and soon entered the army.
units.literal: In youth Hanyun loved books and the classics; he once went to Mount Changbai to lecture and study. When at the end of Tang Qi and Lu were at war and the Liang house was rising to dominance, he threw down his brush and went to pay court, and soon was enrolled in the army.

units.zh: 未幾，出為衛州牙校。
units.en: Soon he became adjutant of Weizhou.
units.literal: Before long he went out as adjutant of Weizhou.

units.zh: 唐天祐中，莊宗入魏，分兵諭其屬郡，時漢筠以利病說衛之牧守，俾送款於莊宗，以漢筠為功，尋移洺州都校。
units.en: During Tang's Tianyou era Zhuangzong entered Wei and sent troops to summon the subordinate commanderies. Hanyun persuaded Wei's governor to submit by arguing the costs and benefits. For this he was soon made chief adjutant of Ming.
units.literal: During Tianyou of Tang, Zhuangzong entered Wei and divided troops to instruct the subordinate commanderies. At that time Hanyun used arguments of advantage and harm to persuade Wei's governor to offer submission to Zhuangzong; taking Hanyun's effort as merit, he was soon moved to chief adjutant of Mingzhou.

units.zh: 其後改常山為北京，以漢筠為皇城使，加檢校兵部尚書、左驍衛將軍同正。
units.en: When Changshan became the Northern Capital, Hanyun was made commissioner of the imperial city with the ranks of Acting Minister of War and regular general of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.
units.literal: Afterward Changshan was made the Northern Capital; Hanyun was made commissioner of the imperial city and given the ranks of Acting Minister of War and regular general of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.

units.zh: 明宗即位，除成德軍節度副使，俄以荊門用軍，促詔漢筠移倅襄州，權知軍州事。
units.en: When Mingzong took the throne he became deputy military commissioner of the Chengde Army. Soon, because Jingmen needed troops, he was urgently transferred to Xiangzhou as deputy with acting authority over military and civil affairs.
units.literal: When Mingzong took the throne he was made deputy military commissioner of the Chengde Army; soon because Jingmen needed troops an urgent edict moved Hanyun to serve as deputy at Xiangzhou with acting authority over military and civil affairs.

units.zh: 長興中，歷曹、亳二州刺史。
units.en: During Changxing he served in turn as prefect of Cao and Bo.
units.literal: During Changxing he served in turn as prefect of Cao and Bo prefectures.

units.zh: 秩滿，加檢校司徒，行左金吾衛大將軍。
units.en: When his term ended he was made Acting Minister of Education and acting great general of the Left Golden Crow Guard.
units.literal: When his term ended he was made Acting Minister of Education and acted as great general of the Left Golden Crow Guard.

units.zh: 清泰末，高祖建義於河東，唐末帝遣晉昌節度使張敬達率師圍太原，委漢筠巡撫其郡。
units.en: Late in Qingtai, when Gaozu rose in Hedong, the Last Emperor of Tang sent Zhang Jingda of Jinchang to besiege Taiyuan and entrusted Hanyun with pacifying the commandery.
units.literal: At the end of Qingtai Gaozu raised the banner of revolt in Hedong; the Last Emperor of Tang sent Zhang Jingda, military commissioner of Jinchang, to lead troops and besiege Taiyuan, and entrusted Hanyun with patrolling and pacifying the commandery.

units.zh: 及敬達遇害，節度副使田承肇率部兵攻漢筠於府署，漢筠乃啟關延承肇，謂曰：「仆與子俱承朝寄，而相迫何甚？」
units.en: After Jingda was killed, deputy military commissioner Tian Chengzhao attacked Hanyun in the government offices. Hanyun opened the gate and admitted him, saying, "We both serve the court. Why press me so hard?"
units.literal: When Jingda was killed, the deputy military commissioner Tian Chengzhao led his unit's troops to attack Hanyun in the government offices. Hanyun then opened the gate and admitted Chengzhao, saying, "You and I alike bear the court's commission—why press me so hard?"

units.zh: 承肇曰：「我欲扶公為節度使。」
units.en: Chengzhao said, "I want to make you military commissioner."
units.literal: Chengzhao said, "I wish to set you up as military commissioner."

units.zh: 澤筠曰：「老夫耄矣，不敢首為亂階，死生系子籌之。」
units.en: Hanyun said, "I am an old man and dare not start a rebellion. My life is in your hands."
units.literal: Hanyun said, "This old man is aged; I dare not be the first to make a ladder of disorder—life and death are in your planning."

units.zh: 承肇目左右令前，諸軍投刃於地，曰：「高金吾累朝宿德，不可枉殺。」
units.en: Chengzhao signaled his men forward, but the troops threw down their blades and said, "Senior Golden Crow Gao is a man of merit through many reigns. He must not be killed."
units.literal: Chengzhao signaled those beside him to advance; the troops threw their blades to the ground and said, "Senior Golden Crow Gao is a man of longstanding merit through many reigns—he must not be killed unjustly."

units.zh: 承肇以眾意難拒，遂謝云：「與公戲耳！」
units.en: Unable to defy them, Chengzhao apologized and said, "I was only joking!"
units.literal: Chengzhao, unable to refuse the troops' will, then apologized, saying, "I was only jesting with you!"

units.zh: 漢筠促騎以還。
units.en: Hanyun spurred his horse and rode back.
units.literal: Hanyun spurred his horse and returned.

units.zh: 高祖入洛，飛詔征之，遇諸途，乃入覲，尋遷左驍衛大將軍、內客省使。
units.en: When Gaozu entered Luoyang he summoned Hanyun by urgent edict. They met on the road, and Hanyun attended court. Soon he became great general of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard and commissioner of the Inner Reception Bureau.
units.literal: When Gaozu entered Luoyang he sent a flying edict summoning him; they met on the road, and he then attended court; soon he was moved to great general of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard and commissioner of the Inner Reception Bureau.

units.zh: 天福三年正月，遘疾，終東京之私第，時年六十六。
units.en: In the first month of the third year of Tianfu he fell ill and died at his home in the Eastern Capital, aged sixty-six.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year of Tianfu he fell ill and died at his private residence in the Eastern Capital, aged sixty-six.

units.zh: 漢筠性寬厚，儀容偉如也。
units.en: Hanyun was generous by nature and imposing in bearing.
units.literal: Hanyun was generous by nature and imposing in bearing.

units.zh: 雖歷戎職，未嘗有非法之言出於口吻，多慕士大夫所為，復以清白自負。
units.en: Though he spent his career in military office, no unlawful word ever left his lips. He admired scholar-officials and prided himself on integrity.
units.literal: Although he passed through military offices, no unlawful word ever left his lips; he greatly admired what scholar-officials did and also prided himself on integrity.

units.zh: 在襄陽，有孽吏常課外獻白金二十鎰，漢筠曰：「非多納枿泬，則刻削阛鋏，吾有正俸，此何用焉！」
units.en: At Xiangyang a corrupt clerk regularly offered twenty ingots of silver as extra tribute. Hanyun said, "Unless you squeeze the people with corrupt levies or market tolls, where does this come from? I have my regular salary. What do I need this for?"
units.literal: At Xiangyang a corrupt clerk regularly levied extra tribute of twenty ingots of white silver. Hanyun said, "Unless you collect more corrupt surcharges or squeeze market tolls, what use is this to me? I have my regular salary!"

units.zh: 因戒其主者不復然，其白金皆以狀上進，有詔嘉之。
units.en: He warned the chief clerk never to do so again, reported all the silver to court, and received an edict of praise.
units.literal: He therefore warned the chief clerk not to do so again; all the white silver was submitted upward in a written report, and an edict praised him.

units.zh: 及蒞濟陰，部民安之，四邑飯僧凡有萬八千人。
units.en: When he took office at Jiyin the people were at peace. In four districts he fed eighteen thousand monks.
units.literal: When he arrived at Jiyin the people of his department were at peace; in four districts he fed monks totaling eighteen thousand persons.

units.zh: 在亳州三年，歲以己俸百千代納逋租，斯亦近代之良二千石也。
units.en: During three years at Bo he each year used a hundred thousand of his own salary to pay overdue rents for the people. He was truly one of the fine prefects of recent times.
units.literal: During three years at Bozhou he each year used a hundred thousand of his own salary to pay overdue rents on the people's behalf—truly a fine prefect of recent times.

units.zh: 長子貞文，仕皇朝，為開封少尹，卒。
units.en: His eldest son Zhenwen served the dynasty as vice intendant of Kaifeng and died in office.
units.literal: His eldest son Zhenwen served the imperial dynasty as vice intendant of Kaifeng and died in office.

units.zh: 孫彥韜，字德光，汴州浚儀人也。
units.en: Sun Yantao, courtesy name Deguang, was from Junyi in Bian.
units.literal: Sun Yantao, courtesy name Deguang, was a native of Junyi in Bianzhou.

units.zh: 少以勇力應募從軍。
units.en: As a youth he volunteered for military service through courage and strength.
units.literal: In youth he volunteered for military service through courage and strength.

units.zh: 梁祖之兼領四鎮，擢彥韜於行間，歷諸軍偏校。
units.en: When the Liang founder concurrently held four commands, he picked Yantao from the ranks and had him serve as a junior commander in several armies.
units.literal: When the Liang founder concurrently held four commands, he picked Yantao out from the ranks and had him serve through the armies as a junior commander.

units.zh: 及唐莊宗與梁軍對壘於河上，彥韜知梁運將季，乃間行渡河，北歸莊宗，莊宗嘉而納之，授親從右廂指揮使。
units.en: When Zhuangzong of Tang faced the Liang army on the Yellow River, Yantao knew Liang's fortune was waning. He secretly crossed the river and returned to Zhuangzong, who welcomed him and made him commander of the personal followers' right wing.
units.literal: When Tang's Zhuangzong faced the Liang army in battle array on the Yellow River, Yantao knew Liang's fortune was nearing its end. He secretly crossed the river by a hidden route and returned north to Zhuangzong. Zhuangzong praised and accepted him and made him commander of the personal followers' right wing.

units.zh: 及莊宗平梁，出為晉州長步都校，加檢校兵部尚書。
units.en: After Zhuangzong pacified Liang, Yantao was sent out as overall commander of the Jinzhou long-step forces and made Acting Minister of War.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong pacified Liang, Yantao was sent out as overall commander of the Jinzhou long-step forces and made Acting Minister of War.

units.zh: 天成初，遷綿州刺史、檢校尚書左僕射。
units.en: At the beginning of Tiancheng he became prefect of Mian and Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was transferred to prefect of Mianzhou and Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 至郡逾年，以考課見稱，就加檢校司空。
units.en: After more than a year in office he was praised in performance review and was promoted to Acting Minister of Works.
units.literal: After more than a year in the commandery he was praised in performance review and was thereupon promoted to Acting Minister of Works.

units.zh: 長興、清泰中，歷密、沂、濮三州刺史，累官至檢校太保，賜竭忠建策興復功臣。
units.en: During Changxing and Qingtai he served as prefect of Mi, Yi, and Pu in succession, rose to Acting Grand Guardian, and received the title Meritorious Minister Who Exhausts Loyalty in Planning Restoration.
units.literal: During Changxing and Qingtai he served in succession as prefect of Mi, Yi, and Pu, rose in cumulative office to Acting Grand Guardian, and was granted the title Meritorious Minister Who Exhausts Loyalty in Planning Restoration.

units.zh: 高祖即位，復授密州刺史，尋卒於任，年六十四。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne he was again made prefect of Mi and soon died in office at the age of sixty-four.
units.literal: When Gaozu took the throne he was again appointed prefect of Mizhou and soon died in office, aged sixty-four.

units.zh: 彥韜出於軍旅，植性和厚，理綿州日，甚著綏懷之譽，故有賞典旌焉。
units.en: Yantao came from the army, and his nature was mild and generous. While governing Mian he won great renown for soothing the people and received commendatory rewards.
units.literal: Yantao came from the military ranks; his nature was mild and generous. While governing Mianzhou he won great renown for soothing and cherishing the people, and therefore received commendatory rewards and banners of honor.

units.zh: 在濮陽，屬清泰末，群寇入郡，郡人大擾，彥韜率帳下百人，一呼破之，人皆感之。
units.en: At Puyang, late in Qingtai, when bandits entered the commandery and threw the people into panic, Yantao led a hundred of his personal troops and routed them with one charge. The people were deeply grateful.
units.literal: At Puyang, late in Qingtai when bandits entered the commandery and the people were greatly disturbed, Yantao led a hundred men from his tent, broke them with one shout, and everyone was moved with gratitude.

units.zh: 但不能守廉養正，以終令譽。
units.en: But he could not preserve his integrity to the end, and his fine reputation did not last.
units.literal: Yet he could not maintain integrity and cultivate rectitude to the end of his fine reputation.

units.zh: 長興中，罷密州赴闕，苞苴甚厚。
units.en: During Changxing, when he left Mi and came to court, he brought lavish gifts.
units.literal: During Changxing, when he left Mizhou and came to court, his gifts and bribes were very heavy.

units.zh: 起甲第於洛陽，逾月而成，華堂廣廡，亞王公之家，見者嗤之。
units.en: He built a grand mansion in Luoyang in little more than a month, with splendid halls and broad corridors rivaling princely residences. Those who saw it mocked him.
units.literal: He built a grand mansion in Luoyang that was finished in little more than a month—splendid halls and broad corridors rivaling the houses of princes and dukes, and those who saw it mocked him.

units.zh: 故淹翔五郡，位不及廉察，抑有由也。
units.en: That is why he served in five commanderies yet never rose to surveillance commissioner. There was reason for it.
units.literal: Therefore he lingered through five commanderies yet never reached the rank of surveillance commissioner—there was reason for it after all.

units.zh: 王傅拯，吳江人也。
units.en: Wang Fuzheng was from Wujiang.
units.literal: Wang Fuzheng was a native of Wujiang.

units.zh: 父綰，偽虔州節度使。
units.en: His father Wan had been military commissioner of false Qian.
units.literal: His father Wan was military commissioner of the false Qianzhou.

units.zh: 傅拯初事楊溥，為黑雲右廂都指揮使，領本軍戍海州。
units.en: Fuzheng first served Yang Pu as commander of the Black Cloud right wing and led his army to garrison Hai.
units.literal: Fuzheng at first served Yang Pu as commander of the Black Cloud right wing and led his army to garrison Haizhou.

units.zh: 唐長興元年，傅拯殺海州刺史陳宣，焚州城，以所部兵五千人來歸。
units.en: In the first year of Tang Changxing, Fuzheng killed Hai prefect Chen Xuan, burned the city walls, and defected with five thousand troops.
units.literal: In the first year of Changxing of Tang, Fuzheng killed Chen Xuan, prefect of Haizhou, burned the city walls, and came over with five thousand troops of his command.

units.zh: 明宗喜而納之，授金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒、曹州刺史，尋移濮州。
units.en: Mingzong welcomed him and made him Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with Golden Seal and Ribbon, Acting Minister of Education, and prefect of Cao; soon he was transferred to Pu.
units.literal: Mingzong was pleased and accepted him, appointing him Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with Golden Seal and Ribbon, Acting Minister of Education, and prefect of Caozhou; soon he was transferred to Puzhou.

units.zh: 清泰中，遷貝州防禦使，秩滿有代，會範延光叛，以兵要傅拯入魏城，疑而不用。
units.en: During Qingtai he became defense commissioner of Bei. When his term ended, Fan Yanguang rebelled and forced Fuzheng into Weicheng with troops, but suspected him and did not employ him.
units.literal: During Qingtai he was moved to defense commissioner of Beizhou. When his term ended and a successor was due, Fan Yanguang rebelled and used troops to force Fuzheng into Weicheng, but Yanguang suspected him and did not employ him.

units.zh: 延光降，高祖授傅拯諸衛將軍，出為寧州刺史。
units.en: When Yanguang surrendered, Gaozu made Fuzheng a guard general and sent him out as prefect of Ning.
units.literal: When Yanguang surrendered, Gaozu appointed Fuzheng a guard general and sent him out as prefect of Ningzhou.

units.zh: 境接蕃部，以前弊政滋章，民甚苦之，傅拯自下車，除去弊政數十件，百姓便之。
units.en: His territory bordered foreign tribes. Former corrupt policies had grown worse and the people suffered greatly. From his first day in office Fuzheng removed dozens of corrupt policies, and the people were greatly relieved.
units.literal: His territory bordered foreign tribes. Because former corrupt policies had grown worse, the people suffered greatly. From the day Fuzheng took office he removed dozens of corrupt policies, and the people found relief.

units.zh: 不數月，移刺虢州。
units.en: Within a few months he was transferred to Guo.
units.literal: In only a few months he was transferred to serve as prefect of Guozhou.

units.zh: 離寧州日，衙門聚數千人，折橋遮道以留之。
units.en: On the day he left Ning, several thousand people gathered at the government gate, broke the bridge, and blocked the road to keep him.
units.literal: On the day he left Ningzhou several thousand people gathered at the government gate, broke the bridge, and blocked the road to keep him.

units.zh: 及赴虢，治理清凈，蒸民愛戴如寧州焉。
units.en: At Guo his governance was clean and pure, and the people loved him as they had at Ning.
units.literal: When he went to Guo his governance was clean and pure, and the common people loved and supported him as they had at Ningzhou.

units.zh: 開運中，歷武州刺史，受代歸洛，遇疾卒。
units.en: During Kaiyun he served as prefect of Wu, was relieved and returned to Luoyang, and died of illness on the way.
units.literal: During Kaiyun he served as prefect of Wuzhou, was relieved and returned to Luoyang, and died of illness on the way.

units.zh: 傅拯家本多財，尤好賓客，及歷數郡，不事生產，將即世，甚貧匱，物論惜之。
units.en: Fuzheng's family had been wealthy and he loved entertaining guests, but after serving in several commanderies he did not attend to production and died very poor. Public opinion regretted it.
units.literal: Fuzheng's family had originally been very wealthy and he especially loved entertaining guests. After serving in several commanderies he did not attend to production, and as he was about to die he was very poor and destitute; public opinion regretted it.

units.zh: 秘瓊，鎮州平山人也。
units.en: Mi Qiong was from Pingshan in Zhen.
units.literal: Mi Qiong was a native of Pingshan in Zhenzhou.

units.zh: 父弘遇，以善射歷本軍偏校，累官至慶州刺史。
units.en: His father Hongyu, a skilled archer, rose through the local army as a junior commander and eventually became prefect of Qing.
units.literal: His father Hongyu, because of skill in archery, rose through the local army as a junior commander and in cumulative office reached prefect of Qingzhou.

units.zh: 瓊亦有勇。
units.en: Qiong too was brave.
units.literal: Qiong too was brave.

units.zh: 清泰中，董溫琪為鎮州節度使，擢瓊為衙內指揮，倚以腹心。
units.en: During Qingtai, when Dong Wenqi was military commissioner of Zhen, he promoted Qiong to adjutant commander and relied on him as a trusted confidant.
units.literal: During Qingtai, when Dong Wenqi was military commissioner of Zhenzhou, he promoted Qiong to adjutant commander and relied on him as a trusted confidant.

units.zh: 及溫琪陷蕃，瓊乃害溫琪之家，載其屍，都以一坎瘞之。
units.en: When Wenqi was captured by foreigners, Qiong killed Wenqi's household, loaded their corpses, and buried them together in one pit in the capital.
units.literal: When Wenqi fell into the hands of the foreigners, Qiong killed Wenqi's household, loaded their corpses, and buried them all together in one pit in the capital.

units.zh: 溫琪在任貪暴，積鏹巨萬，瓊悉輦之，以藏其家，遂自稱留後。
units.en: Wenqi had been greedy and violent in office and amassed vast wealth. Qiong transported it all to his home and styled himself acting commissioner.
units.literal: Wenqi had been greedy and violent in office and amassed tens of thousands in cash. Qiong transported it all to hide in his home and then styled himself acting commissioner.

units.zh: 高祖即位，遣安重榮代之，授瓊齊州防禦使。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne he sent An Chongrong to replace him and made Qiong defense commissioner of Qi.
units.literal: When Gaozu took the throne he sent An Chongrong to replace him and appointed Qiong defense commissioner of Qizhou.

units.zh: 時重榮與蕃帥趙思溫同行，部曲甚眾，瓊不敢拒命，尋橐其奇貨，由鄴中以赴任。
units.en: Chongrong was then traveling with the foreign commander Zhao Siwen with a very large retinue. Qiong did not dare refuse the order, soon packed his valuables, and went through Yezhong to his post.
units.literal: At that time Chongrong was traveling with the foreign commander Zhao Siwen, and his retinue was very large. Qiong did not dare refuse the order. Soon he packed his rare valuables and went through Yezhong to reach his post.

units.zh: 先是，鄴帥範延光將謀叛，遣牙將範鄴持書構瓊，瓊領書不答。
units.en: Earlier Fan Yanguang of Ye was plotting rebellion and sent his adjutant Fan Ye with a letter to recruit Qiong. Qiong received the letter and did not answer.
units.literal: Earlier, Fan Yanguang, military commissioner of Ye, was plotting rebellion and sent his adjutant Fan Ye with a letter to recruit Qiong. Qiong received the letter and did not answer.

units.zh: 使者還，具達其事，延光深忿之。
units.en: When the messenger returned and reported everything, Yanguang was deeply resentful.
units.literal: When the messenger returned and reported everything, Yanguang was deeply resentful.

units.zh: 及聞瓊過其境，密使精騎殺瓊於夏津，以滅其口，一行金寶侍伎，皆為延光所有，由是延光異志益露焉。
units.en: When he learned Qiong was passing through his territory, he secretly sent elite cavalry to kill Qiong at Xiajin to silence him. All the gold, treasures, attendants, and performers in the party fell to Yanguang, and his rebellious intent became still more exposed.
units.literal: When he heard that Qiong was passing through his territory, he secretly sent elite cavalry to kill Qiong at Xiajin to silence him. All the gold, treasures, attendants, and performers in the party fell into Yanguang's possession, and from this Yanguang's rebellious intent was further exposed.

units.zh: 李彥珣，邢州人也。
units.en: Li Yanxun was from Xingzhou.
units.literal: Li Yanxun was a native of Xingzhou.

units.zh: 少為郡之牙吏。
units.en: As a youth he was a commandery adjutant.
units.literal: In youth he was an adjutant of the commandery.

units.zh: 唐天祐中，明宗鎮其地，彥珣素無檢節，因洽於左右，明宗即位，以為通事舍人。
units.en: During Tang's Tianyou era, when Mingzong governed the region, Yanxun was unrestrained and cultivated Mingzong's attendants. When Mingzong took the throne he made Yanxun courier-attendant.
units.literal: During Tianyou of Tang, when Mingzong held that territory, Yanxun had always lacked restraint; he cultivated those at Mingzong's side, and when Mingzong took the throne he was made courier-attendant.

units.zh: 嘗遣使東川，行至其境，其仆從為董璋所收，彥珣竄還，以失敬故也。
units.en: He was once sent as envoy to Dongchuan. When he reached the border Dong Zhang seized his attendants, and Yanxun fled back in disgrace.
units.literal: He was once sent as envoy to Dongchuan; when he reached its border his attendants were seized by Dong Zhang, and Yanxun fled back—for lack of respect.

units.zh: 朝廷攻璋，詔授行營步軍都監。
units.en: When the court attacked Zhang, he was made overall monitor of the campaign infantry.
units.literal: When the court attacked Zhang, an edict appointed him overall monitor of the campaign infantry.

units.zh: 彥珣素不孝於父母，在鄉絕其供饋，同列惡其鄙惡，旋出為外任。
units.en: Yanxun had long been unfilial and cut off his parents' support at home. His colleagues despised his baseness, and he was soon sent to an outside post.
units.literal: Yanxun had always been unfilial toward his parents and cut off their support while in his home district; his colleagues detested his baseness, and he was soon sent out to an external post.

units.zh: 清泰中，遷河陽行軍司馬，遇張從賓為亂，因朋助之，從賓敗，奔於魏州。
units.en: During Qingtai he became acting military secretary of Heyang. When Zhang Congbin rebelled he joined him. After Congbin's defeat he fled to Wei.
units.literal: During Qingtai he was moved to acting military secretary of Heyang; when Zhang Congbin rebelled he joined him as an accomplice; when Congbin was defeated he fled to Weizhou.

units.zh: 範延光既叛，署為步軍都監，委以守陴。
units.en: When Fan Yanguang rebelled he made Yanxun overall monitor of the infantry and entrusted him with defending the walls.
units.literal: When Fan Yanguang rebelled he appointed Yanxun overall monitor of the infantry and entrusted him with defending the parapet.

units.zh: 招討使楊光遠以彥珣見用，欲撓延光而誘彥珣，乃遣人就邢臺訪得其母，令於城下以招之。
units.en: Pacification commissioner Yang Guangyuan, wishing to undermine Yanguang, sent men to Xingtai to find Yanxun's mother and had her call to him from below the wall.
units.literal: The pacification commissioner Yang Guangyuan, because Yanxun was employed, wished to shake Yanguang and entice Yanxun; he therefore sent someone to Xingtai to find his mother and had her call to him from below the wall.

units.zh: 彥珣識其母，發矢以斃之，見者傷之。
units.en: Yanxun recognized his mother, shot her dead with an arrow, and all who saw it were horrified.
units.literal: Yanxun recognized his mother, shot an arrow, and killed her; those who saw it were grieved.

units.zh: 及隨延光出降，授坊州刺史。
units.en: When he surrendered with Yanguang he was made prefect of Fang.
units.literal: When he followed Yanguang out to surrender he was appointed prefect of Fangzhou.

units.zh: 近臣以彥珣之惡逆奏於高祖，高祖曰：「赦命已行，不可改也。」
units.en: Intimate ministers reported Yanxun's crimes to Gaozu. Gaozu said, "The amnesty has already been issued and cannot be changed."
units.literal: Intimate ministers reported Yanxun's wicked rebellion to Gaozu. Gaozu said, "The amnesty has already been issued and cannot be changed."

units.zh: 遂令赴郡，後不知其所終焉。
units.en: He ordered Yanxun to take up his post. Later no one knew his end.
units.literal: He therefore ordered him to go to his commandery; later no one knew how he ended.

units.zh: 〈（《歐陽史》云：彥珣後以坐贓誅。）〉
units.en: (Ouyang Xiu's History records that Yanxun was later executed for corruption.)
units.literal: (Ouyang Xiu's History records: Yanxun was later executed for corruption.)

units.zh: 史臣曰：昔從簡從莊宗戰於河上，可謂勇矣，及其為末帝守於孟津，豈得為忠乎？
units.en: The historiographer writes: Congjian fought with Zhuangzong along the Yellow River—that was courage. But when he held Mengjin for the Last Emperor, where was the loyalty?
units.literal: The historiographer says: In former days Congjian fought with Zhuangzong along the Yellow River—one may call that courage; yet when he held Mengjin for the Last Emperor, how can that be called loyalty?

units.zh: 忠既無聞，勇何足貴！
units.en: Without loyalty, what is courage worth?
units.literal: With no loyalty to speak of, what is courage worth!

units.zh: 潘環、方太，雖鹹負雄幹，而俱歿亂世，蓋方略不足以衛其身故也。
units.en: Pan Huan and Fang Tai were imposing men, yet both died in chaotic times—probably because their strategy was not enough to save themselves.
units.literal: Pan Huan and Fang Tai, though both possessed imposing stature, both perished in chaotic times—probably because their strategy was insufficient to preserve their persons.

units.zh: 何建舉秦、隴之封，附巴、邛之俗，守方之寄，其若是乎！
units.en: He Jian took the seals of Qin and Long and attached himself to the ways of Ba and Qiong—is that what guarding a frontier means?
units.literal: He Jian raised the seals of Qin and Long, attached himself to the customs of Ba and Qiong—is this what is meant by the charge to guard a frontier!

units.zh: 其餘皆儋珪析爵之流也，亦可以垂名於是矣。
units.en: The rest were men who held splintered fiefs and divided noble ranks—yet they too could leave their names on record.
units.literal: The rest were of the sort who held fragmented fiefs and divided noble ranks—yet they too could leave their names in the record.

units.zh: 秘瓊既覆董氏之族，旋為鄴帥所屠，何報應之速也！
units.en: Mi Qiong destroyed the Dong clan and was soon slaughtered by the commander of Ye. How swift the retribution!
units.literal: Mi Qiong had already destroyed the Dong clan, and was soon slaughtered by the military commissioner of Ye—how swift the retribution!

units.zh: 惟彥珣忍射其親，殆非人類，晉祖宥之不戮，蓋失刑之甚也。
units.en: Only Yanxun could shoot his own mother—barely human at all. That Jin Zu spared him was a grave failure of justice.
units.literal: Only Yanxun could bear to shoot his own kin—hardly human. That Jin Zu spared him and did not execute him was surely a grave failure of punishment.
